description: This file defines an abstract class 'Shelf' used as a base for representing user shelves in a book tracking application. It includes properties for the associated user and shelf name, along with methods for equality, hash code, and removing the user reference.

classes.name: Shelf
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a user-defined shelf in the book project, with properties for user association and shelf name, and methods for equality and user removal.

methods.name: Shelf
methods.description: Constructor initializing shelf name and associated user.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Method to disassociate the shelf from its user by setting the user reference to null.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare shelves based on user and shelf name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on user and shelf name.
